item.title: [OpenWrt-RPi4] 3. Bringing up an SSD1306 in U-Boot on an OpenWrt image for the Raspberry Pi 4
item.description:
Goal

  • Bring up an SSD1306 OLED display over I2C in U-Boot running on the Raspberry Pi 4 (bcm2711).

Now that the Pi 4 boots with U-Boot (previous post ), our job is to add SSD1306 display support to it. We start from how the SSD1306 is brought up in the Linux kernel.

item.title: [Android] 1. How to build Android 13 for the Raspberry Pi 4
item.description:
I followed the build guide from Phú's blog: https://vinalinux.com.vn/2024/08/01/xay-dung-android-13-cho-raspberry-pi-4/ . The steps are exactly the same; here I only note a few errors I hit while building.

I used a real machine running Ubuntu 22.04, but a virtual machine such as VirtualBox or VMware works just as well (a VM gets fewer cores for the build, so it takes longer).
